data.title: Policy amendment – private liability insurance
data.summary: Muster Versicherung AG sent Sam Rivera an updated policy document (Nachtrag Nr. 1) for his private liability insurance (Privat-Haftpflichtversicherung), reflecting a change of address and bank details. The annual premium of €59.90 will be collected by direct debit on 1 December 2026, and the contract renews automatically each year unless cancelled at least three months before the end of the insurance year.
data.explanation: This is not a bill needing action from you — it just confirms your new address and bank account are now on file and restates your liability insurance terms. Your bank will automatically be charged €59.90 on 1 December 2026 by SEPA direct debit, so make sure the account has sufficient funds. The contract keeps renewing yearly; if you ever want to end it, you must cancel in text form at least three months before the insurance year ends (30 November). No response is required now unless the address or bank details are wrong.

contract.name: Privat-Haftpflichtversicherung
quotes: Vertragsdauer   1 Jahr mit automatischer Verlängerung um jeweils ein Jahr
Der Vertrag verlängert sich jeweils um ein weiteres Jahr, wenn er nicht spätestens drei Monate vor Ablauf des Versicherungsjahres in Textform gekündigt wird.

items.title: Annual liability insurance premium direct debit
items.action: Make sure the linked bank account has enough funds for the automatic direct debit.

date.text: Der nächste Jahresbeitrag in Höhe von 59,90 € wird am 01.12.2026 von Ihrem Konto abgebucht.

key_facts.quote: Der Beitrag wird jährlich zur Hauptfälligkeit per SEPA-Lastschrift von Ihrem Konto bei der Musterbank eG eingezogen (Mandatsreferenz PHV71-4471220-01).

data.tax_note: Private liability insurance premiums can generally be claimed as special expenses (Sonderausgaben/Vorsorgeaufwendungen) in the German tax return.
